title: SectionIndex configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.SectionIndexAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

IsFixed.description: Keeps the index fixed while the page scrolls.

SmoothScrolling.description: Animates the scroll to the target section.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
